text: FCLoopGLIRaiseDimension[gli, topo] raises the dimension of the given GLI from N to N+2 and expresses it in terms of N-dimensional loop integrals returned in the output.
The algorithm is based on the code of the function RaisingDRR from R. Lee’s LiteRed
topo = FCTopology[ topo1, {SFAD[p1], SFAD[p2], SFAD[Q - p1 - p2], SFAD[Q - p2], SFAD[Q - p1]}, {p1, p2}, {Q}, {Hold[SPD[Q]] -> qq}, {}]
